name: Suzuhara Sorata
source:
A boy who loves science and invention.

He comes from the Heisei Era. He's warped to the past, upon hearing a mysterious song.

He is a briefly playable character during the prologue story. After the player cleared the prologue story, the player will choose one of the three protagonists for the main story.
